title: Police force area data tables
description: ONS police recorded crime for headline offence groups, published quarterly as police force area tables. Table C2 breaks the counts down by community safety partnership area, which maps to local authority districts in England and Wales.

files.note: Police force area tables for the year ending June 2025. Table C2, recorded crime by community safety partnership area, is the sheet the loader reads.
